cities.name: Phoenix
cities.description: Phoenix is a city in Maricopa County in Arizona. It covers about 518 square miles of land and 1 square mile of water, and about 1,665,481 people live there (Census Bureau estimate for July 1, 2025).

government.summary: The Phoenix City Council is a mayor and eight councilmembers, one for each district, elected on a non-partisan ballot for four-year terms.

cities.name: Los Angeles
